documents.title: Directory index and access policy
documents.text: Directory index forbidden by rule is an observed access denial. DirectoryIndex chooses an index file; automatic directory listing depends on Options Indexes. Read the effective directory configuration and index file availability. Do not enable directory listing as a blanket fix. The log alone does not establish which configuration caused denial.
